'''Adarian traveler's wristwraps''' were an item of light [[Armor/Legends|armor]] gloves worn during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. They were [[red]] in color. Whether they were made by the [[Adarian/Legends|Adarian]] [[Species/Legends|species]] or simply named for them is unclear.
